summary.text: Cameron Henry is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 9, representing Jefferson, Orleans, according to the Senate member page.
The Senate biography says Henry was unanimously elected Senate President for the 2024-28 term.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, J. Cameron Henry, Jr. is the 11th President to preside over the Louisiana Senate and is a Republican from Metairie serving his second term.
It says District 9 covers Old Metairie, Old Jefferson and Airline Park, as well as parts of uptown New Orleans.
The biography says he previously served 12 years in the Louisiana House of Representatives for House District 82 and chaired its Appropriations Committee.

The biography says Henry graduated from Jesuit High School in 1992, received a bachelor's degree in Political Science from LSU in 1997, and earned an MBA in Finance and Management from Tulane in 2004.

It says that while working on his MBA he served as legislative aide to then-state Rep. Steve Scalise, and that in July 2006 he completed the Executives in State and Local Government program at Harvard University's John F. Kennedy School of Government.

The Senate member page lists Cameron Henry's committee assignments as Capitol Security Council; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget; Legislative Budgetary Control Council; State Bond Commission; Senate Executive Committee (Ex Officio).
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
